$comment: Machine-readable pointer to the CURRENTLY REQUIRED version of each document. The backend reads this (from its own cached copy, never live at request time) and compares against the version each user accepted. Published version directories are IMMUTABLE — see README. Version strings carry a document prefix on purpose: the accepted-version value is stored as a bare string on the user row, so identical values across documents would let a tos-vs-privacy comparison bug pass silently.
